_purpose: Site-search vocabulary. Nothing here is shown on a page; it only widens what the search box understands. 'synonyms' are groups of words a buyer may use for the same thing: a query containing any member also matches the others. 'products' adds per-machine search-only variants (old names, misspellings, model typos) keyed by product slug. Number words are handled in app.js (three = 3, 3-in-1 = 3 in 1) and need no entry. Seeded from the corrections in terminology.json; the full list goes to the client for review in Batch B.
